s.note: prawn on cucumber, and she's not invited
s.how: Poach 300g green prawns for 2 minutes, chill and peel. Cut 2 cucumbers into thick rounds. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp tomato sauce. Top each round with a prawn, a dot of sauce and a dill sprig and serve cold on a tray.

s.note: the big pitch in the boardroom
s.how: Mix 400g crab meat, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon, chopped parsley and 60g breadcrumbs. Shape 12 small cakes, chill 20 minutes and pan-fry in butter for 3 minutes a side. Serve with lemon wedges and 150g tartare sauce.

m.how: Sear 2 large sirloins hard, rest and slice thin. Toss 2 heads cos with 250g halved cherry tomatoes and thin red onion. Whisk 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 6 tbsp oil and Dijon. Top with the steak and 100g crumbled blue cheese.

w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Whisk 3 whites with 150g sugar over hot water, then beat in 250g butter. Layer with raspberry jam and chill.

d.note: the ferry in from Staten Island
d.how: Stir 60ml bourbon, 30ml sweet vermouth and 2 dashes bitters with ice for 30 seconds. Strain into 4 chilled coupes and drop a maraschino cherry in each.
